summary.zh: 更省能量的邪恶攻击、更重的刺骨，再加 3% 命中，招招不落空。完全不点防御天赋。
summary.en: A cheaper Sinister Strike, a harder Eviscerate, and 3% hit so nothing whiffs. No defensive talents at all.

scenario.zh: 10–20 级，野外与地下城的纯输出
scenario.en: Levels 10–20, straight damage in the world and in dungeons

pros.zh: 强化邪恶攻击让主力技能少消耗 5 点能量，一场战斗下来接近多打一次。
pros.en: Improved Sinister Strike takes 5 Energy off your main builder, which is close to one extra strike per fight.

pros.zh: 强化刺骨让终结技伤害提高 20%。
pros.en: Improved Eviscerate adds 20% damage to your finisher.

pros.zh: 穿刺之伤让背刺暴击几率提高 30%，并有 45% 几率额外产生 1 个连击点。
pros.en: Puncturing Wounds adds 30% critical strike chance to Backstab and gives it a 45% chance to add a combo point.

pros.zh: 精确提供 3% 命中，避免浪费本就紧张的能量。
pros.en: Precision adds 3% hit, removing the misses that waste Energy you cannot spare.

pros.zh: 躲闪与招架类天赋是刻意跳过的：20 级的 PvE 内容还打不出需要它们的伤害。
pros.en: Dodge and parry talents are skipped deliberately: at level 20 nothing in PvE hits hard enough to need them.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
